text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're warming up before training, when…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sigh… My legs feel kinda heavy today…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But maybe overcoming situations like this is just what I need to become an outstanding racer…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: My legs feel like lead… But I'll do my best… So heavy… Gotta keep going…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Matikanetannhauser is fatigued from all the racing she's been doing. I'll need to rethink her race schedule.
